title: PBX <-> Switch: trunk auth / tenant identification
description: Mirror of redfire-switch IpAuthConfig for the PBX platform interconnect. The PBX egresses from source_networks; each tenant is identified by a tech_prefix that resolves to a switch customer_id (== boss voice_accounts.switchAccountId). Keep this in sync with redfire-switch authentication.rs IpAuthConfig.

tech_prefix.description: Per-tenant account key; matches techprefix contract
